title: Portify Canonical Design Tokens
description: Machine-readable canonical design tokens. Tranche 1A/1A.1/1A.2 scope: color, radius and spacing. COLOR is generated from 10-design/DESIGN-SYSTEM/RUNTIME/portify-shared.css (the file the closed neutral-palette decision, PDS-017/033, is actually bound to in live canon); RADIUS is generated from 10-design/DESIGN-SYSTEM/CANONICAL-RADIUS-DECISIONS.json (only the radius values that trace to a closed PDS decision); SPACING is generated from 10-design/DESIGN-SYSTEM/CANONICAL-SPACING-DECISIONS.json (Product Owner-approved Option 3B, 2026-09-02 — a closed 10-value primitive set, see the Tranche 1A.2 governance record §14). Neither the color nor the radius source has a primitive/alias layer, so this artifact has no top-level 'primitive' key — every semantic color value is already final.

domainsIncluded.description: Which token domains this specific artifact actually populates with real values. A domain absent here has no canonical values yet and must never be filled with fabricated or borrowed-from-a-non-canonical-source data.

semantic.description: Theme-dependent semantic color tokens, fully resolved to concrete hex/rgba values (no var() references — this artifact is meant to be consumed directly, not re-resolved).

radius.description: Theme-independent corner-radius tokens. Only values that trace to an explicitly closed PDS decision — not a general-purpose scale.

spacing.description: Theme-independent spacing tokens. Product Owner-approved v1 (Option 3B, 2026-09-02): a closed 10-value primitive set plus an optional, currently-empty semantic-alias layer. 'primitive' values are restricted by enum to exactly the approved set — an unapproved value fails closed at validation, not just at generation time.

primitive.description: The approved v1 spacing primitives. Closed set — do not add a value here without another canonical Design System decision.

semantic.description: Semantic spacing aliases. Empty in the v1 decision — no candidate currently meets ONLY_STABLE_CROSS_SYSTEM_MEANINGS. Present as an object (not absent) so a future decision can populate it without a breaking schema change.
